P045.authors: K Wang, Z Zhu, L Xu
P045.label: Wang等（2022）

complete_examples.text: It is equivalent to the Gaussian closure method (Iyengar and Dash 1978) when the system is subjected to purely external Gaussian white noise.

Therefore, in the present article, the EPC method is extended and improved for solving the transient PDF solutions of stochastic oscillators with even nonlinear restoring force and damping force under external Gaussian white noise.
